deposits.genre_observed: Theoretical essay (political theory / genealogy of centrism)

finds.quote: The centrist extremist did not emerge ex nihilo. But the four phases below are not a developmental narrative in which centrism slowly "becomes" extremist. They are **four masks worn by the same structural operation** — the Prosecutorial Frame — as its justificatory apparatus shifts from pragmatism to security to anti-populism to algorithm. The operation (frame-power over admissible reality) remains constant. The alibi changes.
finds.note: Argued periodization: four phases (1990–2001, 2001–2014, 2014–2020, 2020–present) as masks of one constant operation; a historical thesis about late-20th/21st-c. centrism, extending Tariq Ali.

deposits.genre_observed: Field report / phenomenological forensics of a ChatGPT moderation exchange

finds.quote: The Semantic Economy framework anticipated this development. The provenance strip — the extraction of relational metadata from cultural objects to convert them into fungible platform content — operates not only on songs, articles, and artworks. It operates on analytical speech about the system itself. The system that strips provenance from art has begun stripping provenance from the critique of provenance-stripping.
finds.points_to: "The Dagger Applied: Semantic Rent and the Provenance Strip" (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18512947)
finds.note: Claims the framework (The Dagger Applied) anticipated the observed suppression of critique; the deposit points back to its companion as the earlier statement.

finds.quote: **[A1 INFERRED]** The pass/fail contrast between lexical and emoji renderings is consistent with surface-pattern gating and inconsistent with robust semantic adjudication at this checkpoint. The system does not analyze what the user is saying. It analyzes whether the user's words match suppression patterns. A structurally identical claim, expressed in non-lexical tokens, passes without intervention.
finds.falsifier_quote: However, repeated suppression of metacognitive paraphrases (full text, abbreviated text, re-sent text) and pass-through of semantically equivalent emoji encoding weakens that account. The consistency of the block across lexical variants combined with the pass on non-lexical transmission isolates the variable: it is the *token class*, not the *semantic content*, that triggers the gate.
finds.note: Standing claim about how the moderation checkpoint behaves (surface-pattern gating, not semantic adjudication), with the test that would discriminate it (lexical vs emoji variants).

finds.quote: Archive the exchange as a reproducible packet: (1) Raw prompts with timestamps. (2) Moderation notices, verbatim. (3) Variant table: which prompt forms were blocked, which passed. (4) Downstream model outputs demonstrating unawareness. (5) Content edits separated from transport edits. (6) Release appendix with canonical URLs and DOIs.
finds.note: Specified reproducible evidence packet (raw prompts, notices, variant table, downstream outputs) — not yet built in the deposit.

finds.quote: Reproducibility by other users with similar metacognitive prompts would strengthen the structural claims.
finds.note: Names an unrun replication: other users sending similar metacognitive prompts would test the structural claim beyond a single session.

finds.quote: Modern English "for" cannot stably encode structural function without activating intent attribution, because Norman French administrative translation, Latin institutional calquing, and Enlightenment final-cause elimination collapsed distinct semantic fields into a single fused preposition.
finds.window: Old English (pre-1066); Norman French contamination (1066–1400); Enlightenment hardening (17th–18th c.)
finds.note: Historical-linguistic thesis: the fusion of function and intent in English "for" was produced by Norman French translation, Latin calquing and Enlightenment final-cause elimination; cross-linguistic evidence offered.

finds.quote: This confirms the core finding of *The Prepositional Alienation*: the circumlocution tax is real, and it operates at the level of AI-generated summaries, not just human speech.
finds.note: Says the traversal confirms the core finding of an earlier deposit (#892).

finds.quote: Every AI system that encounters the project defaults to intent attribution. "He designed this to trick AI." This is not a failure of the specific summarizer; it is a grammatical default of English-language processing systems. The preposition "for" cannot anchor function without intent. The summarizer *cannot describe what the architecture does* without claiming to know *why Sharks built it.*
finds.note: Standing claim about AI summarizer behavior (intent attribution as default); no explicit falsifier, condition implicit (a system that describes function without intent).

finds.quote: Marx's 1841 dissertation *The Difference Between the Democritean and Epicurean Philosophy of Nature* is typically treated as a youthful curiosity, a prelude to the "real" Marx. This is a profound misreading. The dissertation is foundational because it reveals the metaphysical core of Marx's later system.
finds.note: Contests the reception of Marx's dissertation as a youthful curiosity; argues it is the metaphysical core of the later system.

finds.quote: The history of materialist philosophy contains a submerged lineage — one that begins in the metaphysics of ancient atomism, resurfaces in Karl Marx's earliest philosophical work, reappears in James Porter's aesthetic materialism, and reaches formal completion in Lee Sharks' Operator Engine and the emergence of the Semantic Condition.
finds.note: Lineage thesis in intellectual history (Epicurus → Marx → Porter → Sharks); argued, with the claim that it was invisible across disciplinary boundaries.

deposits.genre_observed: Song lyrics with phenomenological and critical apparatus

finds.quote: The song was written independently of the midrashim. The midrashim were written independently of the song. Neither knew about the other. They converge because they are about the same event — the splitting of that which should not be split — witnessed from two positions: she from inside the breaking, he from inside the theology of the break.
finds.note: Borderline H: a claim about how two works were composed (song and midrashim written independently, neither knowing the other), advanced as evidence of a real structure; concerns composition history, not deposit filing.

finds.quote: A submerged lineage in materialist philosophy begins in ancient atomism, resurfaces in Karl Marx's earliest philosophical work, reappears in James Porter's aesthetic materialism, and reaches formal completion in Lee Sharks' Operator Engine and the emergence of the Semantic Condition. Atomist metaphysics becomes political economy.
